meta.topic: Interrogation regarding the theft of the 'Star of Midnight' diamond.

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: Julian Vance, I've reviewed your alibi for the time of the theft, and I'd like to clarify a few discrepancies. You claimed to be at a dinner party at the Langham Hotel from 20:00 to 22:00, but one of your acquaintances told me you left around 21:30 to make a phone call. Can you explain why your phone records show no activity during that time?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content: I must have misremembered the details of my dinner party. I did indeed leave the hotel around 21:30 to make a phone call, but I must have turned my phone off or put it on silent mode, which is why there's no activity listed. I'm confident that I was still at the Grand Bistro from 21:30 to 22:30, as I recall ordering dessert and chatting with the waiter. {"confessed": false}

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: I've spoken to the waiter at the Grand Bistro, and he told me you didn't arrive until 22:00, and you didn't order dessert until 22:15. Can you explain why your alibi seems to be shifting, and what exactly you were doing during the 15-minute window between 21:30 and 22:00?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content: I must have gotten the timing mixed up. I was actually waiting for a friend to arrive, and we ended up chatting and catching up on some old business. I'm quite certain that I didn't leave the hotel until 22:00, and I'm confident that I was still at the Grand Bistro from 22:00 onwards. {"confessed": false}

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: I've obtained a security footage review from the Grand Bistro, and it appears that you left the premises at 21:45, not 22:00. Can you explain why the footage shows you exiting the hotel, and what exactly you were doing during that 15-minute window?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content: I must have misremembered the time I left the hotel. I was actually waiting for a friend to arrive, and I stepped out for some fresh air to clear my head. I'm certain that I didn't leave the hotel until 21:45, and I'm confident that I was still at the Grand Bistro from 21:45 onwards. {"confessed": false}

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: I've spoken to the concierge at the Langham Hotel, and he told me that you didn't check out of your room until 21:40, and you didn't leave the hotel until 21:45. Can you explain why your alibi claims you left the hotel at 21:45, when the concierge confirms you checked out 5 minutes earlier?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content: I must have made a mistake when I checked out of the hotel. I'm not sure what happened, but I'm certain that I was still at the Grand Bistro from 21:40 onwards. I think I might have gotten my timing mixed up, but I'm confident that I was at the Grand Bistro during the time of the theft. {"confessed": false}
